headline: Maximizing 100,000 Chase Points for Business Class to Europe via Aeroplan
reasoning: This topic offers high travel relevance and reader value by detailing a specific, actionable strategy for using points for premium travel. It's timely due to the limited-time Chase offer and provides clear, step-by-step guidance. The source, The Points Guy, is a highly credible and established authority in the points and miles space.
summary: The article outlines how to leverage a 100,000 Chase Ultimate Rewards bonus, specifically transferring points to Air Canada Aeroplan, to book business class flights to Europe for as few as 60,000 points one-way.

source_articles.title: How to use 100,000 Chase points to fly business class to Europe
